top_signals.title: Record port congestion exposes maritime’s collaboration problem, says PortXchange
top_signals.summary: PortXchange says the latest rise in global port congestion underscores why shipping, ports, terminals, and service providers need to share information earlier and make decisions from a common operational picture. Record levels of global port congestion are exposing a wider problem in maritime: an industry that talks about collaboration and resilience still too often reacts ...
